background: QNB is the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa by assets, majority-owned by the Qatar Investment Authority, funded by Qatari and Gulf deposits and lending to the Qatari government and its related entities, with subsidiaries in Turkey and Egypt.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, one on a negative outlook and two on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 28 Mar 2024. No capital or liquidity ratios are shown here, so the ratings carry the assessment. The negative outlook taken by one of the three is the point to watch. The newest flagged item, on 8 Oct 2026, is third-quarter earnings ahead of estimates.
